title: A Modern Web App in C
why_read: A deep dive into building a modern web application using plain C is a genuinely unusual and educational systems-programming exercise.
analysis: This piece likely explores building web app backend/frontend infrastructure using C instead of typical higher-level web frameworks, touching on memory management, HTTP handling, and templating from scratch. Such projects are valuable for engineers wanting to understand what frameworks abstract away and for appreciating low-level performance tradeoffs. The high comment count suggests spirited debate about practicality versus a learning exercise.
